name: Amtu-Heddu-Anna
source:
Amtu-Heddu-Anna is a member of the inner circle of the Order of the Universal Panacea. She is the oldest amongst them, specialized in the almost obsoleted technique of runescripting directly onto people's bodies. Even outside of her specialty, she's one of the most prestigious runecrafters in the Remaining World.

[From [url=https://everblossom.miraheze.org/wiki/Amtu-Heddu-Anna]The Flower That Bloomed Nowhere Wiki[/url]]
